messages:
Aisha (CSM): Morning team — quick health-check thread for Fenwick's private/VPC deploy tomorrow. Main asks: networking egress & peering, IAM roles for service accounts, KMS key policy + rotation, and audit log delivery. Any immediate blockers on your side? :wave:
Jordan (Fenwick): Thanks Aisha. We're on for the window. My infra lead is Marcus. Two quick asks: 1) do you need a public egress IP for audit delivery? 2) how do we provide the KMS principal?
Marcus (Network Eng): For audit/log delivery (Splunk/collector) you can either: a) allow outbound to our Splunk IP range via NAT, or b) create a PrivateLink endpoint to the collector. We prefer NAT with a stable EIP. Also need the Redwood CIDR for peering config and a list of healthcheck ports.
Aisha (CSM): Noted — Redwood can use NAT + EIP. I'll DM the CIDR and healthcheck ports, but for the channel: default health ports are 443 (API), 3306 (metrics probe if enabled), and 22 for support tunneling (we prefer SSM though).
Priya (Security Eng): KMS: we need a Key Policy entry for the Redwood service principal and a role ARN that Redwood will assume. Example minimal policy snippet to add to the CMK: ```json
{
  "Sid": "AllowRedwoodService",
  "Effect": "Allow",
  "Principal": {"AWS": "arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/redwood-kms-proxy"},
  "Action": ["kms:Encrypt","kms:Decrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey"],
  "Resource": "*"
}
```
Please replace the account ID with your account. Also enable automatic rotation (annual) and provide an alias like `alias/redwood-fenwick-cmk` so our deploy scripts reference it.
Sam (DevOps): On the agent/proxy side: we'll need the following in your proxy config to push logs to S3/Splunk: ```yaml
forwarder:
  destination: s3://fenwick-redwood-audit
  kms_key_alias: alias/redwood-fenwick-cmk
  compress: true
```
If you can't expose S3, we can ship via HTTPS to your collector endpoint.
deploy-bot: Created ticket #CS-4132 for Fenwick private deploy preflight (assign: Marcus, Priya, Sam). Link: https://redwood.atlassian.example/browse/CS-4132 :white_check_mark:
Jordan (Fenwick): Ok we can do EIP + NAT. I'll create the S3 bucket and add a bucket policy that allows Redwood's logging role to PutObject. Who should I grant?
Priya (Security Eng): Grant the role ARN we gave above (arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/redwood-logging-role). Also enable server-side encryption with the CMK. Example S3 policy line: ```json
"Principal": {"AWS": "arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/redwood-logging-role"}
```
Make sure to restrict prefix to `audit/` and enable SSE-KMS.
Aisha (CSM): Quick FYI on account health/renewal: Fenwick is on a 6mo pilot. Our CS goal is go-live in 2 weeks. If onboarding slips >30 days, that becomes a renewal risk — we should capture that in the ticket and escalate if blocked. Please flag anything that could push the timeline.
Marcus (Network Eng): Firewall rule change queued — scheduled for tomorrow 02:00 UTC. I also need the exact EIP we should expect so we can create a static route and NAT mapping. Jordan will post the EIP once provisioned.
Jordan (Fenwick): Will post EIP later today. Also one small ask: can Redwood rotate the key every 12 months automatically, or do we need to coordinate?
Priya (Security Eng): Rotation can be automatic on the CMK. We generally ask vendors to allow automatic AWS-managed rotation and to not require manual re-key for rollout. Redwood's runtime supports KMS key ARN aliasing, so rotation should be transparent as long as alias is stable.
Sam (DevOps): Two practical notes: 1) Our agent will attempt a healthcheck at first connect — if your NAT blocks outbound until change is live the connect will fail; we'll retry for 30 mins. 2) If you use SSM for support tunnels, add the role `arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/redwood-ssm-access` to instance profile.
Aisha (CSM): Great — owners: Marcus (network), Priya (security/KMS), Sam (ops), Jordan (customer). Next step: 30-min sync tomorrow at 08:30 PDT to confirm NAT/EIP, KMS policy applied, and S3 bucket ready. Can everyone confirm? :calendar:
Marcus (Network Eng): Confirmed.
Priya (Security Eng): Confirmed.
Sam (DevOps): Confirmed.
Jordan (Fenwick): Confirmed.
Aisha (CSM): Also adding a short feedback capture plan: we'll send a 3-question form at day 7 post-go-live (ease of setup, clarity of docs, any blocker). That will feed renewal health scoring. If any of you see repeated friction, flag it so I can log in our renewal tracker.
Jordan (Fenwick): Sounds good. One micro-feedback: the KMS policy docs were a little terse — could you add a copy-paste example for the role & alias? That would have sped up our infra PR.
Aisha (CSM): Good feedback — noted. I'll add a concrete copy-paste snippet to the onboarding playbook and attach to CS-4132.
deploy-bot: CS-4132 updated: files attached (onboarding-playbook/kms-example.md).
Aisha (CSM): Closing thread for now — will reopen after the sync with any blockers. Thank you all! :sparkles:
